title: Shifted unit isomorphism data for derived pullback
statement: Under the noetherian proper monoidal hypotheses, the derived pullback of the shifted monoidal unit is isomorphic to the shifted unit.

proof.text: Construct the comparison from the monoidal derived pullback and translated-unit argument.

lean.statement: theorem exists_derivedPullback_shifted_unit_iso {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ Y) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)] : Nonempty ((derivedPullback f).obj ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅ (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Z))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
